description: A three-quarter arc tracking progress toward a goal, with the count shown in the center.
overview: Uses `RadialBarChart` with `innerRadius="72%"`, `startAngle={225}`, `endAngle={-45}` and `barSize={16}`, and one `RadialBar` with `cornerRadius={20}` and a 22% `color-mix` tinted background. `chartData` holds a single `{ name, value, fill }` record with `value` 64 and `fill` set to `var(--color-value)`; `chartConfig.value` uses `var(--orange)`. A `PolarAngleAxis` with `type="number"` and `domain={[0, 100]}` (ticks and axis line hidden) makes the bar's length a percentage of the full arc rather than of the largest value. An absolutely positioned overlay shows 16 / 25 and a caption.
usage: Set `value` to your progress as a percentage of the goal and update the overlay text, which is static. Change `startAngle` and `endAngle` to open or close the arc.
notes: There is no tooltip; the center text carries the value. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `RadialBarChart`, so the chart is focusable from the keyboard.
